cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)

find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(sensor_node)

target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c src/sensor_sim.c)

# The demo CA certificate (public part only) is generated by `make certs` and
# embedded as DER. The firmware trusts exactly this CA for the MQTT broker.
set(DEMO_CA_DER ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../certs/generated/demo-ca.der)
if(NOT EXISTS ${DEMO_CA_DER})
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing ${DEMO_CA_DER}: run `make certs` first")
endif()
set(gen_dir ${ZEPHYR_BINARY_DIR}/include/generated)
generate_inc_file_for_target(app ${DEMO_CA_DER} ${gen_dir}/demo_ca.der.inc)
